# MCP tool catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/tool-catalogue.mjs from src/registry.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

The server registers **79 tools**. Every entry is declared in
`src/registry.ts` with its schema, handler, risk class, approval requirement,
path policy, provenance source and test references. Registration is a loop over
that registry, so a tool cannot be added without those decisions.

## Output content

Every registered tool returns MCP text content. `adb_screenshot` and
`compose_preview_render` additionally return inline PNG image content
(`image/png`). No tool returns an MCP resource or embedded file: tools that
persist files report the path and metadata as text. `tool_catalog` returns
structured JSON encoded as text. Every other tool is text-only.

## environment (2)

| Tool | Impact | Risk | Approval | Unattended | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `android_env_check` | `read-only` | `read-only` | none | yes | `mcp` |
| `sdkmanager_install` | `external-write` | `external-write` | confirmation required | no | `build` |

### `android_env_check`

Check installed Android toolchain (java, gradle, adb, emulator, sdkmanager, maestro, compose-preview, android CLI) and environment variables.

- Impact: `read-only`
- Preconditions: Node.js and the host Android toolchain are installed
- Side effects: `host-read`, `process-spawn`
- Verification: npm test — smoke registration and toolchain detection tests
- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`, `test/build-info.test.mjs`

### `sdkmanager_install`

Install or update Android SDK packages through sdkmanager, downloading artefacts from Google's repositories.

- Impact: `external-write`
- Policy key: `sdk.install`
- Preconditions: sdkmanager is on PATH; SDK licences are accepted; Network access to Google repositories
- Side effects: `external-download`, `host-write`, `process-spawn`
- Safer alternative: Install SDK packages through Android Studio's SDK Manager
- Verification: npm test — smoke registration; live install requires an SDK host
- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`

### `android_project_inspect`

Inventory a Gradle Android project: modules, SDK/namespace/build-type fields, source sets and manifests; read-only, never runs builds or returns secret values.

- Impact: `read-only`
- Preconditions: ANDROID_MCP_WORKSPACE covers the project, APK or output path used
- Side effects: `host-read`
- Path arguments: `projectPath` (read)
- Safer alternative: Run gradlew tasks or read the Gradle files by hand
- Default timeout: 120000 ms
- Output limit: 24000 bytes
- Verification: npm test — smoke registration and project-inspect tests
- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`, `test/project-inspect.test.mjs`

### `android_release_notes_generate`

Draft release notes from a Git ref range with commit-linked items, separate user-facing and engineering notes, and review flags; never publishes or writes files.

- Impact: `read-only`
- Preconditions: ANDROID_MCP_WORKSPACE covers the project, APK or output path used
- Side effects: `host-read`
- Path arguments: `projectPath` (read)
- Safer alternative: Write release notes by hand from git log
- Verification: npm test — smoke registration and release-notes tests
- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`, `test/release-notes.test.mjs`

- Side effects: `project-build`, `process-spawn`, `device-write`, `host-write`
- Path arguments: `projectPath` (read)
- Safer alternative: Generate the profile from Android Studio's Baseline Profile module

- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`

### `adb_battery`

Read the device battery status through dumpsys battery.

- Impact: `read-only`
- Preconditions: An authorised Android device or emulator is connected and visible to adb
- Side effects: `device-read`, `process-spawn`
- Verification: npm test — smoke registration; battery reads need a device
- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`

- Impact: `device-state`
- Policy key: `device.state.write`
- Preconditions: An authorised Android device or emulator is connected and visible to adb; The receiving app is installed
- Side effects: `device-write`, `process-spawn`
- Safer alternative: Trigger the flow from the app's own test harness
- Verification: npm test — smoke registration and broadcast validation tests
- Tests: `test/smoke.test.mjs`, `test/tools.test.mjs`

## Planned, not registered

These names appear in design notes and feature requests but are **not
registered**. Calling them fails; the table exists so documentation cannot
be mistaken for a working capability.

| Tool | Status | Summary | Tracking |
|---|---|---|---|
| `screenshot_diff` | `not-implemented` | Pixel-diff a capture against a named golden baseline. Baselines are saved and listed by screenshot_baseline_save/list in the persistent captures archive; the diff engine itself is tracked by #18. | #16, #18 |
| `design_qa_matrix` | `not-implemented` | Capture light, dark, font-scale and landscape variants as one contact sheet. Use Robolectric/Roborazzi variants in app tests for now. | #18 |
| `a11y_audit` | `not-implemented` | Audit tap targets, labels and sampled contrast over uiautomator. Use Roborazzi accessibility checks in app tests for now. | #18 |

## Safe subset

`tool_catalog` with `safeOnly: true` returns only tools with `approval: none`
and `unattended: true`. That view is a discovery aid, not an OS sandbox: the
workspace path policy and the execution boundary still apply to every call.

## Test inventory

`node scripts/tool-catalogue.mjs --test-inventory` prints a TSV row per tool
with `referenced` or `registration-only` coverage and the test files it names.
The inventory is generated from this registry so the #97 contract work can
consume the same source rather than maintaining a second list.
